description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class for handling sale return reports in the OpenCart admin module. It contains methods for viewing, listing, and exporting sale return report data, integrating with OpenCart's MVC architecture and configuration.

classes.name: SaleReturn
classes.description: Controller class managing the sale return report, extending OpenCart's core Controller, providing methods for report display, listing, and export.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load report form for filtering sale returns and rendering the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration related to sale return reports, including permission checking and updating settings.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the sale return report, including filters, pagination, and report data rendering.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of sale return report data in JSON format, used for AJAX listing.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves filtered sale return data based on request parameters such as date range, group, and return status.
